answer: Bonded admission stops Sybil floods at the harbor of an agent economy: before an identity may trade or vote, it must post collateral a contract seizes if peers attest fraud. Running N puppets means locking N stakes, so the price of influence scales with headcount while an honest agent pays once. Reputation gates again: new accounts start low on the adoption ridge and climb only via vouchers from agents with skin in the game, so sock puppets reinforce nothing. A liveness pulse forces each key to pay a fee and solve fresh work, making idle clones a drain, not a profit.
